suggestions.point: The plan relies on the fine_grained_classifier to distinguish 'statue' from 'animal'. Since standard ImageNet classifiers may not have a specific 'stone raccoon statue' class, this could lead to false negatives or confusion. It is recommended to explicitly task the perceptual_quality_auditor with verifying the material properties (texture/lighting) to confirm the 'stone' attribute if the classifier is ambiguous.

The artifact observations note fused paws and structural ambiguity. While the perceptual_quality_auditor is selected, adding the topology_boundary_auditor could provide more rigorous segmentation of the paws/tails against the background rocks to mathematically verify the 'fusion' artifacts observed.
